source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade HIB-CPLD firmware through web UI
(Need to do AC cycle after flash complete).

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + HIB-CPLD image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: -- HIB-CPLD upgrade/downgrade via the BMC web UI: the agent first places the exact user-provided HIB-CPLD image where the web-UIs upload control expects it, then drives the HIB-CPLD flash page (upload image, start update, wait for completion) with host must be powered off first; an AC cycle is required after flash completes; after completion verify the HIB-CPLD version. Interactive web-UI upload is not a single sshpass one-liner; walk the UI steps after the image is in place.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return screenshots + the flash-completion status and the HIB-CPLD version shown before/after so the user confirms a successful flash and a clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: RISK: HIB-CPLD firmware flash via web UI is state-changing and can brick the BMC/host if interrupted; AC cycle after flash is mandatory; flash only the user-specified image and do not interrupt mid-flash.

original_test_intent: Upgrade and downgrade the HIB-CPLD through the BMC WebUI while the host is off, then perform the required AC cycle and verify active interconnect-board logic plus server recovery.
original_method: An engineer selects/commits each HIB-CPLD image in WebUI, observes terminal status, executes the approved AC-cycle activation, and checks the HIB-CPLD version, BMC access, host POST/OS and logs.
manual_activity: The engineer must perform and observe the destructive WebUI selection/commit/progress core and control any physical hand-off required by the approved AC-cycle method.
required_inputs: Exact HIB board/CPLD revision and signed upgrade/downgrade images
Vendor WebUI programming and AC activation procedure
HIB-CPLD version and interconnect/platform health expectations
Known-good recovery image and independent console/OOB path
safety_requirements: Validate HIB board revision and CPLD target before image selection; do not rely on filename alone.
Treat initial host-off state and later AC removal/restoration as separate documented phases.
Use the project-approved AC-cycle mechanism; this row does not mandate Seq 182 physical cable removal.
Never retry, reverse or repeat power after uncertainty; preserve WebUI, BMC, link, power and SEL evidence.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare immutable HIB image/device evidence, collect baseline board/BMC/host data, monitor approved power telemetry and gather independent post-AC version/connectivity/health evidence.
Do not perform the manual WebUI core or assign the final verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve/perform each WebUI update and AC-cycle hand-off.
Assess HIB-CPLD activation, affected connectivity and platform recovery, then issue verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It preserves the correct host-off and AC requirements, but browser automation cannot replace manual WebUI acceptance and clean-single-reset is not source truth.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor WebUI manually and approved AC controller; validate the IPMI raw version field against the HIB-CPLD instance and revision.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The host-off state, HIB-CPLD WebUI, AC cycle, script and 5/30-minute values remain.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED HIB-CPLD UPDATE WITH INTERCONNECT-AWARE AC VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the signed image to the exact HIB-CPLD, capture WebUI terminal state, perform one controlled AC activation, then verify active version and HIB-associated link/device health along with BMC reachability and host boot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Systems whose HIB-CPLD is supported by the BMC WebUI and requires AC activation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record HIB hardware/CPLD image, BMC/WebUI/browser, version-readback and power-controller versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor HIB-CPLD programming, activation, interconnect validation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact HIB instance binding, interconnect-aware post-checks, power telemetry and recovery gates.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects a CPLD version that appears updated while HIB links/devices fail after AC restoration.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved HIB transition and power plan.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: HIB link topology and affected devices are platform-specific and must be named; a generic version string is insufficient.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define images, HIB link checks and AC mechanism/timing. Completion applies only to that HIB revision and approved plan, not other interconnect boards or physical-removal methods.
expected_evidence: Approved HIB board/CPLD identity and image hashes
Host-off/BMC-standby baseline including HIB-linked device topology
Post-AC HIB-CPLD version, link/device state, BMC and host health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets HIB-CPLD through WebUI with host off and mandatory AC activation. Missing version/link/power values are project inputs; the historical clean-single-reset phrase is excluded.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target and lifecycle are understandable. Project artifacts do not make the case permanently blocked; manual WebUI core controls classification.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps HIB/AC scope while rejecting browser substitution and unsupported reset language.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains critical controls and changes BLOCKED to MANUAL ONLY.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Adds HIB link/device acceptance and preserves the case-specific AC boundary.

review_improvement: Extends evidence from a generic CPLD version to interconnect-board functionality after AC activation.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correct HIB-CPLD version does not alone prove the host interconnect recovered. The source workflow is clear after project inputs, but its WebUI update/observation remains a manual core operation.
